scope: Local browser diagnostic; not a webcam recognition or new accuracy test

source.dimensionObservation: Initial loaded-data observation; baseline canvas dimensions pinned here. A normal guide playback later reported 1920x1080; this first run did not audit intrinsic dimensions at every seek.

tracker: Existing Tasks Holistic CPU VIDEO loader, fresh instance per condition
sampling: Sequential seeks to source timestamps at 8 or 25 fps; not realtime throughput
padding: Centered black padding, aspect-preserving drawImage; original pixels retained for 1920-wide conditions
correction: Diagnostic centered x offsets times sourceAspect/referenceAspect; y/z/confidences/timing unchanged; confidence-zero placeholders unchanged
limits: All conditions passed existing camera quality gates; model weights and acceptance gates unchanged.
These runs use one already-known validation reference; no claim of unseen-signer accuracy.
Diagnostic correction is not wired into live inference. Low-resolution corrected input still rejects.
No fabricated hold tail, duplicated pose frames, expected-label input or user camera recordings.
Separate actual webcam check verified decoded 1280x720 and live shoulders; no actual HELLO performance was demonstrated.
